§3§lPreparation and use§r
Shift-right-click the Link Terminal to select Power mode, then right-click a supported machine with readable energy output to install the power cover. Power mode shows a purple §13 × 3§r guide grid. Tick this quest after understanding energy upload.

§3§lUpload and losses§r
Each tick, the cover draws up to §1V × A EU§r from available machine output into its buffer, then uploads it at each grid interaction. The default interval is §1600 ticks (30 seconds)§r with §10%§r uplink loss. Its buffer limit is Long.MAX_VALUE. Configure the interval and losses in config/gtswn/gtswn_network.cfg.

§3§lOutput restrictions§r
The cover blocks output to physical cables on that face to prevent double counting; it draws no energy from machines without output. The machine chunk must remain loaded for collection and upload.
